name: Vermilion -Bind of Blood-
source:
Toshirou is in charge of managing public order in the city. Along with a community of vampires, they purge those that commit crimes. However, they come upon a monster which is said to have massacred many in the past.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
